Anthropic API Key

Optional — for illustrated (not vector) statblock artwork, using OpenAI's image API instead of Claude-drawn SVG. Costs roughly 1–15¢ per image, billed to your own OpenAI account. Get one at platform.openai.com

OpenAI API Key (optional)
Backup & Switch Devices

Everything lives only in this browser — there's no cloud sync. To continue on another device: export a backup here, transfer the file to the other device (email, USB, cloud drive), then open Lorebound there and import it.

Importing replaces all data on the device you import into — export from your other device first if it has anything you want to keep.
